summary: Tested PipelineGuard backend (8 pytest tests) and frontend (Ingest/Pipeline/Health/DealDetail flows). 7/8 backend tests pass. All frontend flows work: sidebar nav, sample load, AI analyze, Globex auto-match, confirm & navigate to deal detail with new activity, kanban 5 columns with 12 cards + 'No next step set' warnings, Health stat cards + Recharts leaderboard best-first, reseed. One backend bug: POST /api/extract with 'not interested' text returns sentiment='neutral' instead of 'negative' — negative sentiment lexicon does not include closed-lost trigger phrases.

minor.issue: 'not interested' text correctly maps stage=Closed Lost but sentiment stays 'neutral' — NEGATIVE_WORDS list has 'concerned/worried/hesitant/…' but not 'not interested/not a fit/competitor/no thanks'. Requirement expects sentiment='negative'.

issues: Recharts logs harmless console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1)' during first paint before ResponsiveContainer measures — visual chart renders fine, but consider setting min-height on chart wrapper to silence warning.

action_items: Fix extract_from_text sentiment: when suggested_stage=='Closed Lost' or when 'not interested'/'not a fit'/'went with a competitor' phrases are present, set sentiment='negative'.
(Optional polish) Add min-height/aspect to Recharts ResponsiveContainer to eliminate console warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: extract_from_text sentiment logic is purely word-count based and doesn't couple to Closed-Lost keyword hits, causing the failing 'not interested' spec.
server.py: @app.on_event('startup') is deprecated in FastAPI; consider lifespan handlers.
server.py: startup_seed calls seed() which deletes all data on empty DB — safe on empty but the check-then-act is fine here; note POST /api/seed is destructive with no auth (acceptable for MVP).
server.py: datetime.fromisoformat used on stored ISO strings — OK, but storing native datetimes in Mongo would be more idiomatic.
Frontend: images (rep avatars) load from external URLs — if these fail there's an AvatarFallback initials, so fine.
seed_data_creation: Called POST /api/seed at test start to guarantee 3 reps + 12 deals; confirm test appended activity 'TEST_ Confirmed...' on first deal.
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py in /app/backend/tests/ has 8 pytest tests. The only failure is sentiment for Closed-Lost extract. Frontend is fully functional. If main agent fixes the negative-sentiment lexicon (e.g., add 'not interested','not a fit','competitor','no thanks' to NEGATIVE_WORDS OR force sentiment='negative' when Closed Lost stage detected), rerun `pytest backend/tests/backend_test.py -v`.
